content: सौर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [सूरस्य इदं सूरो देवतास्य वा अण्] .²1 Relating to the sun, solar. .²2 Sacred or dedicated to the sun. .²3 Worshipping the sun. .²4 Celestial, divine. .²5 Relating to spirituous liquor. .{@-रः@} .²1 A worshipper of the sun; <ls>Mb. 7. 82. 16</ls>. .²2 The planet Saturn. .²3 A solar month. .²4 A solar day. .²5 The plant called Tumburu. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Yama, the god of death. .{@-रम्@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a collection of hymns (extracted from the Ṛgveda) addressed to {%Sūrya%}. .²2 The right eye.
सौरी .²1 The wife of the sun. .²2 A cow.
